question: In which of the following districts of Gujarat is the ‘Statue of Unity’ located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada**__.__**​**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The statue of unity is a statue of Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel, the** 'Iron Man of India'.**
 
• It was inaugurated on the **143rd birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.**
 
• It overtook the Spring temple Buddha statue as the world's tallest statue.
 
• The height of the statue is 182m, that of the pedestal is 58m and hence the height of the statue from the base is 240m.
 
• It was designed by the Indian Architect** Ram V Sutar**.
 
• It has been constructed near the Sardar Sarovar Dam built on the **Narmada River **In the **Narmada district of Gujarat**.
